leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply descendant selectors to style nested HTML elements.
Construct child selectors to target direct descendants within a parent element.
Differentiate between descendant and child selector syntax in CSS rules.
Implement combined descendant and child selectors to create specific styling hierarchies.
Manipulate CSS specificity by applying descendant and child selectors to override base styles.
Configure a CSS stylesheet to use descendant and child selectors for structured layout control.
Update existing CSS rules by replacing element selectors with descendant or child selectors for more precise targeting.
